title: Databricks AI Runtime SDK replaces serverless_gpu
summary_text: Starting in GPU environment version 6, the Databricks AI Runtime SDK ( databricks-sdk-air ) replaces the deprecated serverless_gpu package. It provides the @distributed and ray_init APIs and the databricks.air.data utilities under the databricks.air namespace. The gpus and gpu_type arguments are renamed to num_accelerators and accelerator_type . The old names still work in databricks.air but emit a FutureWarning , and support will end in version 7. Serverless GPU environment version 6 includes both packages. Version 6 is the last version that includes serverless_gpu . Versions 5 and below continue to use it. See Migrate from serverless_gpu .

title: File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents is now generally available
summary_text: File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents is now generally available, so workspace admins no longer need to turn on a preview. Upload files to a conversation and analyze them in natural language alongside your other data. For supported file types and limits, see Upload a file and Upload a file to a Genie Agent . File upload in Genie One isn't supported for users who have only consumer access .

title: Consumer access to query Unity Gateway services is generally available
summary_text: Users with the consumer access entitlement no longer need an account admin to enable the "Consumer access to Unity Gateway" preview to query the model services and model provider services shared with them, or to use Unity Gateway coding agent features. See Consumer access capabilities . This change can increase model traffic from consumer access users, including traffic to external providers. To control this traffic, account admins can set budgets and rate limits, or disable direct model access, for consumer access users. See Manage budgets for Unity Gateway , Apply rate limits to model and MCP services , and Manage entitlements .

title: MySQL integrated CDC pipeline is now generally available
summary_text: The integrated CDC pipeline for MySQL is now generally available. An integrated CDC pipeline ingests change data from MySQL into Databricks using a single pipeline, combining extraction and application into one pipeline update. Unlike the standard gateway-based architecture, an integrated CDC pipeline requires no separate ingestion gateway. See Create an integrated CDC pipeline for MySQL .

title: Parameters for Lakeflow pipelines are now generally available
summary_text: Pipeline parameters are now generally available. Parameterize Lakeflow pipeline SQL source code with key-value pairs so a single pipeline can run against different catalogs, schemas, or tables without editing the source. Define parameter defaults in pipeline settings, override them when you start an update, and reference them in SQL with named parameter syntax. See Use parameters with pipelines .

title: Lakebase Search supports Chinese, Japanese, and Korean full-text search
summary_text: The lakebase_tokenizer extension now supports keyword search over Chinese, Japanese, and Korean (CJK) text. These languages don't separate words with spaces, so native PostgreSQL full-text search can't split them into useful search terms. The new tokenizer_morph template uses morphological analysis with bundled language dictionaries to segment CJK text into words: Built-in configurations : installing the extension creates tokenizer_chinese , tokenizer_japanese , and tokenizer_korean . Use them directly with to_tsvector without creating a dictionary. Compound handling : choose a mode that keeps compound words whole, splits them into finer-grained terms, or emits both, depending on the language. Language-aware filtering : drop Japanese particles and function words, convert Japanese terms to their base form, and filter Korean particles and endings, so matches focus on meaningful terms. Like tokenizer_wholeword , it produces standard tsvector values that work with GIN (generalized inverted index) indexes and the lakebase_text lakebase_bm25 index for BM25 (best match 25) ranking. CJK support ships in lakebase_tokenizer 0.2.0. If you already use the extension, run ALTER EXTENSION lakebase_tokenizer UPDATE . Your existing configurations and indexes don't need to change. See lakebase_tokenizer .
